description: Punti accesso wifi Provincia Prato is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by dati.provincia.prato.it. Wifi access points in the provincial territory, the various accesses are punctual and are reported both those operating and those planned, but not yet installed. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "WiFi access points Province Prato" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
